_comment: Released stable skill ids — APPEND-ONLY (ADR-0006, 12r-a). The append-only-ids eval fails if any id here disappears from game-core/content/skills/*.ron, and — since 12r-a — also fails if a LIVE id is not pinned here. Derived by reading the RON by hand in glob-sorted filename order (000-core.ron: 1 Ember, 2 Fire Fang, 3 Water Gun, 4 Aqua Jet, 5 Vine Whip, 6 Razor Leaf core · 7 Rain Dance, 8 Sunny Slam, 9 Sandblast, 10 Hailstrike weather setters (M14d/ADR-0095) · 11 Toxic Sting status applier (M14e/ADR-0096) · 070-wave3.ron: 40 Spark, 41 Thunder Fang Electric kit, 42 Glimmer, 43 Radiant Lance Light kit (rw3b/ADR-0204) = 15 ids), then cross-checked against parseIds — NEVER generated from parseIds, because a baseline derived from the extractor under test is self-confirming and forbidden. AUTHOR OBLIGATION: a content PR that adds a skill id MUST append it here in the SAME PR; this list may only ever GROW, never shrink, and it carries an EXACT expected DISTINCT-id count (15 for skills today) pinned in TWO places the eval reads independently — the production `BASELINE_ID_FLOORS` constant and the tooth-owned `baselineFloor` table — BOTH of which that same PR must bump. It is an exact pin, not a minimum: a count below it means a baseline was shrunk, so restore the content and the pin (never lower the number to match); a count above it means content grew without the ratchet. That is what closes the self-consistent 'delete the content and un-pin it in one commit' shrink, the add-one/retire-one swap that leaves the count unmoved, and duplicate or `-0` padding (which inflates the array's length while `Set` collapses it) — every entry here must be a DISTINCT plain integer. SCOPE LIMIT — this gate detects id REMOVAL and UNPINNED GROWTH only, NEVER id REUSE or rebinding: swapping 7 and 8, or reusing id 7 for an entirely different skill, stays green (catching that needs a map-shaped baseline like evolution-path-edge-ids.json — a named follow-up). parseIds is also flat and depth-blind, so a nested `id:` sub-record inside a skill entry is now a HARD FAIL with NO correct remediation: its number is harvested as a live id, and neither answer is right — pinning it writes a non-id into an append-only baseline permanently, and rewriting it as `id=N` (the convention for prose) is not valid RON for a real field, so the loader returns Err. Do NOT pin it and do NOT mangle the field; that needs a depth-aware extractor in its own slice.
